items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Kiddawa would play every Monday night, you know. Kiddawa was playing trombone.

ctx.x: Uh, right when I checked that right there now on, uh, on, uh, Tremont Street.

Every, every Monday night with Kid Oliver. Uh, right when I checked that right there now on, uh, on, uh, Tremont Street. Every Monday night, Kiddawa would play every Monday night, you know. Kiddawa was playing trombone. They had a front porch. The front porch, the band would come out on the evening and the front porch, the dance start at 8 o'clock, the band would come on the porch around about 7.30, the front porch. Them guys, these are plebs on the music on that front porch.
